Attach successful producer/action snapshot before caller assertions; original producer errors remain primary when diagnostic snapshot fails.
Original native targets, anchor, presentation delay, ahead-of-main-clock and shared-counter guards, onset/end tolerances, cancellation and owner checks remain unchanged.
